options.name: no ledger (pre-FIX41 snapshot only)
notes: the client is told to reload the message from the API when a resume fails

options.name: in-process slice (chunk 1)
notes: resume across a restart is impossible: the only copy is this process's memory

options.name: Redis list, one RPUSH per frame (synchronous)
notes: a per-frame cost that reads as free is not free 400 times

options.name: Redis list, pipelined off the hot path (in-memory stays the read path)
notes: the turn pays a channel send; the round trips happen behind it
a frame can be in flight when the process dies — the window is one flush interval

options.name: Postgres table (one INSERT per frame, migration 080)
notes: measured on an UNLOGGED table — a real (logged) one is slower, so this is the optimistic bound
needs a cleanup job; chat-edge would be writing every token of every turn to durable storage
